body:
Independent adversarial Step 7d review at `7d35035f6c521c69fad94f73381c6a6eb7251fff` found four CAS registry-row comments that concatenate the former and current ontology parent as if both were current. Scientific identity and predicate cells are correct.

The affected rows are:

- `MIM:Beta-Glycerophosphate_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate` → `cas:154804-51-0`: `Registry/identity row preserving cas:154804-51-0 alongside parent CHEBI:17270. Registry/identity row preserving cas:154804-51-0 alongside parent CHEBI:132089.`
- `MIM:D-Glucuronic_Acid_Sodium_Salt_Monohydrate` → `cas:207300-70-7`: `Registry/identity row preserving cas:207300-70-7 alongside parent CHEBI:4178. Registry/identity row preserving cas:207300-70-7 alongside parent CHEBI:32144.`
- `MIM:EDTA_Tetrasodium_Tetrahydrate_Salt` → `cas:13235-36-4`: `Registry/identity row preserving cas:13235-36-4 alongside parent CHEBI:4735. Registry/identity row preserving cas:13235-36-4 alongside parent CHEBI:750784.`
- `MIM:Maltotriose_Hydrate` → `cas:312693-63-3`: `Registry/identity row preserving cas:312693-63-3 alongside parent CHEBI:61993. Registry/identity row preserving cas:312693-63-3 alongside parent CHEBI:140999.`

Root cause: the bounded Step 7d projection carries both historical and current comment prose without labelling the former text as superseded.

Fix scope: change only these four canonical comment cells to distinguish historical from current prose; preserve the exact original comment/projection/receipt artifacts as evidence. Reconstruct the same unpublished batch 25 using guarded native publication, keeping the preceding 24 receipts byte-identical. Do not create a second mapping batch or change owners, scientific cells, snapshot, tests, thresholds, or approvals.

Acceptance: native receipt replay and QC pass; all 105 selected rows retain WITHHOLD; independent re-review of the final head resolves the exact finding lineage.

Evidence: `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/step7d-execution-20261103/independent-review/projection-subreview/finding-001-stale-parent-comments.json` (SHA-256 `a5c281b0651f4aa439ec3eb5a9a8e87f88e37a219d88d62297fa8e04f00a2dd6`). Native review identity: `20261103T064120Z-step7d-independent-stale-parent-comments`; issue key: `step7d-stale-parent-registry-comments`.

Deduplicated against all 121 live open issue/PR records; no matching existing defect found. Related scope: #901 and #1120.
title: Step 7d registry comments present superseded ontology parents as current
